issues.display_title: Issue #1710: Restyle manage subscription dialog with marketing UI
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

Restyle the billing settings "Manage Subscription" dialog to match the newer marketing dialog language used by the profile share/delete dialogs and the updated payment method dialog.

Scope

  • Update the manage subscription dialog markup in src/app/pages/settings/billing/pricing-plan/pricing-plan.component.html.
  • Add or update dedicated scoped styles for the manage subscription dialog in src/assets/scss/primeNg/_dialog.scss.
  • Preserve all existing subscription actions and data bindings.
  • Keep styles isolated so other PrimeNG dialogs are not affected.

Acceptance Criteria

  • The manage subscription dialog uses the new marketing-style modal shell: rounded card, soft backdrop, modern close button, icon/header treatment, and polished spacing.
  • Current plan, price, next billing date, progress, and days-left content remain visible and readable.
  • Primary actions remain clear: change plan and stop subscription.
  • Cancel/close behavior remains unchanged.
  • Unsubscribe confirmation and success dialogs keep their current styles unless explicitly restyled in a separate task.
  • The layout is responsive on mobile widths.
  • pnpm build:dev:ssr completes successfully.

Notes

Use the existing profile share/delete dialogs and the updated payment method dialog as visual references. Avoid broad .p-dialog changes.

Update

The billing PrimeNG dialog styling added in this issue has been reorganized by the new dialog stylesheet refactor.

The payment method and subscription management dialog styles now live in focused PrimeNG dialog partials instead of the old large global dialog file:

  • src/assets/scss/primeNg/dialog/_payment-method.scss
  • src/assets/scss/primeNg/dialog/_manage-subscription.scss
  • src/assets/scss/primeNg/dialog/_billing-legacy.scss

The billing components and their existing dialog class names are still preserved. This update only changes stylesheet ownership and maintainability.

Related follow-up work:

issues.display_title: Issue #1711: Refactor PrimeNG dialog styles into modular SCSS partials
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

Refactor the large global PrimeNG dialog stylesheet into smaller, domain-based SCSS partials.

Background

src/assets/scss/primeNg/_dialog.scss had grown too large and mixed unrelated dialog styles in one file. This made it hard to find dialog-specific styles, increased the chance of selector conflicts, and made future PrimeNG dialog maintenance harder.

Scope

  • Replace the single _dialog.scss entry with src/assets/scss/primeNg/dialog/_index.scss.
  • Split dialog styles into focused partials:
    • auth
    • confirm
    • billing
    • editor
    • artworks
    • viewer
    • subscription
    • alerts
    • shared base styles
  • Add reusable dialog shell styles:
    • v-dialog
    • v-dialog-mask
    • v-dialog-mask--blur
  • Update src/styles.scss to import assets/scss/primeNg/dialog/index.
  • Remove the obsolete _dialog.scss wrapper.

Acceptance Criteria

  • PrimeNG dialog styles are loaded through dialog/_index.scss.
  • The old large _dialog.scss file is removed.
  • Existing dialog class names keep working.
  • pnpm build:dev:ssr passes.

issues.display_title: Issue #1712: Move profile dialog styles to owning components
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

Move profile-related PrimeNG dialog styles out of the global dialog stylesheet and into the components that own them.

Background

Profile delete/share dialog styles were part of the global PrimeNG dialog styles, even though they are only used by profile and account settings components. This made global CSS larger than needed and kept feature-specific styles away from their owners.

Scope

  • Move gallery profile dialog styles into:
    • src/app/pages/profile/main/main.component.scss
  • Move account delete dialog styles into:
    • src/app/pages/settings/account-setting/account-setting.component.scss
  • Remove src/assets/scss/primeNg/dialog/_profile-modern.scss.
  • Remove profile-modern import from dialog/_index.scss.
  • Clean up dead bulk-selection code from the profile main component:
    • template block
    • TS state/methods
    • specs
    • unused SCSS selectors
  • Remove unused account settings dialog styles:
    • profile-share-dialog
    • share-dialog
    • sd-*
    • cd-hint
    • unused dialog-local primary button variant

Acceptance Criteria

  • Profile dialog styles live in the owning component SCSS files.
  • Global PrimeNG dialog styles no longer include profile-specific dialog styles.
  • Dead bulk-selection code is removed.
  • pnpm build:dev:ssr passes.
